question: What is the meaning of geometry in relation to revision of the original design?
description: Geometry refers to the shape and spatial arrangement of building components, which can influence the revision of the original design during construction. Changes in geometry may be necessary to accommodate unexpected site conditions, material availability, customer needs, or updated regulations. These revisions can involve adjustments to material specifications, structural modifications, and layout alterations to better meet practical needs or updated regulations. Geometry plays a crucial role in ensuring the building's functionality, quality, and service life.
